name: Diagram Isotype
tagline: Pale-blue canvas with chevron process arrows, stacked layer bars in blue, orange, teal and violet, and outlined line-icon tiles (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Pale blue ground, navy ink, one primary blue plus orange, teal and violet category colors

typography.style: Single-family IBM Plex Sans with bold titles, tracked blue section labels and semibold diagram text

best_for: Explaining a platform, process or architecture with arrows, layers and icons. Suits enterprise and product audiences who need the structure understood quickly.
avoid_for: Emotional storytelling or minimalist keynotes where one image should carry the slide.
